messages:
maria lin: FYI bringing up weights+tokenizer for 'open-constellation-3B' — needs intake checks before we push to registry. I put the artifacts in s3://redwood-models/temp/open-constellation/

tony cho: Thanks maria. Do we have HF model id & license? Need to confirm license is compatible before we ingest.

maria lin: HF id: openai/open-constellation-3b (source tarball attached). License: Apache-2.0. Model card is in the bucket at model_card.md.

ashwin rao: Can someone paste the exact S3 path + checksum so I can verify ingest script? Also which KMS key to use for registry?

maria lin: path: s3://redwood-models/temp/open-constellation/open-constellation-3b.tar.gz
sha256: 7f3a2b9c1d4e6b0a8e6c9f1d5b2a4f8c9e7d3b1a0c6e5f4b2a9d8e7c6b5a4f3d
kms: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789

ci-bot: [upload-scan] Artifact scan: no known malware signatures. License check: Apache-2.0 detected. Hash match pending manual verify.

eva: Quick checklist idea — before registry entry we should: 1) checksum verify, 2) tokenizer version pin, 3) test decode/encode roundtrip on 1000 random samples, 4) run eval harness (QA+LLM-kb small), 5) quick quantization smoke (int8) to ensure no crash.

tony cho: +1. Also confirm tokenizer vocab size and special tokens. Some community models rename <s> token. If tokenizer mismatch, embeddings and tokenization tests will fail.

maria lin: Tokenizer path: s3://redwood-models/temp/open-constellation/tokenizer.json
vocab_size: 50288
special_tokens: {"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","unk_token":"<unk>"}

ashwin rao: Running quick checksum/untar now. Command I ran:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/temp/open-constellation/open-constellation-3b.tar.gz ./ && sha256sum open-constellation-3b.tar.gz
```
Output matched the provided sha256.

tony cho: Great. Next: we need a registry entry draft. Minimal fields: model_id, version, source_uri, checksum, tokenizer_uri, license, tags (priority/quantization-ready). I'll create a PR to registry after eva signs off on evals.

eva: I kicked off eval harness on a small prompt set (200 prompts): baseline perplexity, QA EM, safety heuristics. Early numbers: QA EM 68.2%, perplexity ~ 12.7 on our dev split. No obvious safety red flags in quick scan, but will run the safety classifier ensemble.

maria lin: Thanks. On quantization — we did a quick int8 with bitsandbytes and it completed but output diverged on some long-context prompts. Logging in s3://redwood-models/temp/open-constellation/quant-int8/logs.txt

ashwin rao: Can you paste the command you used for int8? We need to reproduce for the quant suite.

maria lin: Command snippet:
```
python -m run_quant --model-path ./open-constellation-3b --quant backend=bitsandbytes,mode=int8 --save ./quantized/int8
```
We used padding_truncation=right, kv_cache enabled.

eva: Divergence on long context might be kv cache precision. Add a short-run eval with 1k token context and compare logprobs. If divergence is significant, tag as "quant-smoke-fail" and keep float32 as primary.

tony cho: I'll draft the registry PR with tags: ["open-constellation","3b","apache-2.0","quant-smoke-pending"]. Once eva posts final eval artifacts, I'll update PR.

maria lin: One operational note — we should rotate the temp bucket to the registry bucket with server-side encryption + KMS and add S3 object-level metadata: original-hash, upload-user, upstream-hf-id. I'll run the transfer after checksum+eval green.

ci-bot: [registry] created draft entry model=open-constellation-3b version=0.1 state=draft by=tony cho

tony cho: PR link: https://git.internal.redwood/models-registry/pull/427 — please review. Adding reviewers @ashwin rao @eva

ashwin rao: Reviewing now. Also suggest adding acceptance criteria: unit tests (tokenizer roundtrip), smoke decode tests, and a perf baseline (latency 95p on p3-small).

eva: I'll upload eval reports to s3://redwood-models/temp/open-constellation/evals/ and paste links once done. Expect final by EOD.

maria lin: Perfect. Once evals are in and PR LGTMs, I'll promote artifacts to s3://redwood-models/registry/open-constellation/0.1/ and notify security for audit.

tony cho: Nice work team. Quick thumbs: :thumbsup:

eva: LGTM.

maria lin: Closing for now — will follow up with promotion once final checks pass.
